novelty_search.nearest_results: The exact will/had L9H1/H4 source partition found that the unchanged two-token subject onset supplies 68.7% of the full reader effect in A1 and 55.7% in A2, while the literal temporal cue supplies 22.1% and 39.2%. The analogous has/had source bank first became behaviorally sufficient at residual boundary 5, but no experiment has localized when the will/had subject-onset payload is written.
novelty_search.new_question: At what residual boundary does the unchanged will/had subject-onset state become sufficient to transfer the temporal decision, and is it written by boundary 5 as the cross-construction precedent predicts?

population: All 64 sealed A1/A2 will/had discovery rows, split into two fixed 32-row construction batches with both transfer directions retained.

interventions.subject_onset: Simultaneously replace the determiner and head-noun residual states immediately after the temporal cue with paired donor states at one registered boundary.
interventions.cue_control: Replace only the sole Tomorrow/Earlier or tomorrow/earlier temporal-cue residual state at the same boundaries.
interventions.boundary_semantics: Boundary 0 is the normalized token embedding; boundary n>0 is the residual state after block n-1.
interventions.operator: Exact paired state replacement at only the declared semantic group, retaining every other base state and the complete base suffix.

opposing_predictions.early_contextual_writer: The subject-onset state crosses the fixed causal sufficiency bar by boundary 5, matching or preceding the analogous has/had contextual source-bank onset.
opposing_predictions.late_or_distributed_writer: The subject-onset state does not cross until boundary 6-9, or never crosses before the fixed L9 reader, implying a later or distributed upstream computation.
opposing_predictions.literal_cue_control: The cue can be live at boundary 0 because its token identity changes, but its curve cannot rescue a missing or late subject-onset crossing.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_instru: All hashes and native capability hold; manual selected logits replay frozen native logits within 1e-4; every semantic position is aligned; subject-onset boundary-0 donor/base states and scored logits are exactly unchanged within 1e-7.
predictions.pred_b_subject_onset_becomes_sufficient: At least one subject-onset boundary 1-9 has mean donor recovery at least 0.50 and donorward fraction at least 0.80 in both A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_c_early_onset_by_boundary5: The earliest subject-onset boundary passing B is at most 5.
predictions.pred_d_literal_cue_control_reported: Report the complete cue-only curve under identical interventions, including its potentially live boundary-0 effect; it cannot alter B or C.
predictions.pred_e_exact_zero_fit_price: Exactly 44 model forwards, 1408 example evaluations, 1280 arm-row records, and zero fits/searches/backwards/updates.

terminal.screen: A, B, C, and E pass; D is descriptive. License the crossing block interval for writer localization.
terminal.null: The run is valid but the subject-onset state either never crosses through boundary 9 or first crosses after boundary 5; retain the exact late/no-onset classification and both curves.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, replay, semantic alignment, boundary-0 invariance, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.

scope: This experiment localizes when a complete semantic source-state bank becomes sufficient for the end-to-end behavior. It does not identify a unique head or MLP writer and does not claim the literal cue is the dominant L9H1/H4 source.
